frozen_by_process: Evaluation_FeatureEngineering ablation (dev-only) -> Evaluation_V5Candidate threshold selection (dev-only) -> one-time locked-test evaluation (Evaluation_V5Candidate/LockedTest)
not_a_diagnostic_tool: This is a research/prototype visual-concern score, not a melanoma/cancer probability and not a diagnosis.

model.artifact_sha256_note: byte-identical to Evaluation_V5Candidate/v5_reference_model.pkl, fit once on all 2,089 valid development rows -- never refit, including after locked-test results were seen
model.fit_on: development cohort only (Evaluation_FinalTargeted/Cohort/development_manifest.csv), n=2089 SINGLE_LESION_EVALUABLE rows with all 17 features present; locked test never used for fitting

feature_order_note: StandardScaler's fitted mean_/scale_ arrays are positional. Feature vectors MUST be assembled in exactly this order at inference time -- see pipeline_v5/decision_model.py::featurize.

feature_provenance.base_6_source: revised_abcd/pipeline_v2.py (unchanged); same values V4 already uses
feature_provenance.new_11_source: pipeline_v5/feature_extraction.py::extract_v5_new_features (color+border+geometry group from Evaluation_FeatureEngineering/run_ablation_cv.py's BEST_COMBO_FEATURES, unchanged, no further feature search performed after selection)

threshold_selection_method: Development-only grouped-OOF sweep over {0.20,0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45,0.50}; select max balanced accuracy among thresholds with sensitivity>=0.55 AND specificity>=0.55 (identical rule to V4's own Evaluation_V4/select_threshold.py). Not re-tuned after seeing locked-test results. Coincidentally equal to V4's own threshold -- not chosen to match it.
decision_rule: elevated_visual_concern = (decision_score >= 0.25); score is a logistic-regression decision score, not a melanoma probability

order: YOLO single-image segmentation (see yolo_dependency below) -> produces the raster mask
required_preprocessing.note: This is the EXACT chain revised_abcd/pipeline_v2.py already runs for V2/V3/V4 -- V5 adds no new preprocessing step, it only adds feature computations on top of the same mask/no_hair/circle_info outputs.

yolo_dependency.note: V5 does not change YOLO in any way -- same checkpoint, same inference call, same mask output V2/V3/V4 already use.
yolo_dependency.checkpoint_resolved_via: MelanomaDetection/MelanomaDetection.Python/yolo_config.py::get_yolo_weights_path() (default models/yolo_melanoma_seg.pt, overridable via YOLO_WEIGHTS_PATH env var)
yolo_dependency.checkpoint_known_source_path: C:\Users\sirjanaa\Downloads\runs\runs\segment\melanoma_yolo26n_seg\weights\best.pt (the same checkpoint used to build cohort_v2_results.csv, i.e. every A/B/C/D/confidence/lesion_fraction value V4 and V5 both consume)
yolo_dependency.inference_call: revised_abcd/yolo_single_image.py::run_single_image_inference(model, image_path, conf=0.25) -- single-image (unbatched), retina_masks=True, masks thresholded at raw>0.5
yolo_dependency.multi_instance_policy: Every detected instance kept separately, sorted by confidence descending, instance 0 = primary. NOT unioned. V5, like V4, scores only the primary instance; other instances must remain visible/communicated (see MultiLesionNotice.razor on user-shree) but should not be silently dropped.

diameter_calibration.D_px: always populated (pixel-based, from YOLO mask, unchanged)
diameter_calibration.D_mm: NOT available -- mm_per_px is not computed by V5 (or by V2/V3/V4). Hair-width-based calibration (VELLUS_HAIR_UM, measure_hair_width_px) is the OLD classical-pipeline-only approach and must NOT be restored for V5.
diameter_calibration.D_px_normalized: V5's own new feature: D_px divided by sqrt(image height x image width) -- a scale-normalized diameter proxy, NOT a physical mm measurement.

excluded_candidates.note: Tested in the ablation study but NOT part of the final frozen V5 feature set -- do not add these without a new, explicitly-approved feature-selection round (this freeze forbids further feature search).

locked_test_policy: Run exactly once, per V4's own precedent. Not repeated, not used for any further tuning.
